messages:
Alex Chen: Hey finance team — quick one. My corporate card was declined at an ATM in Lisbon yesterday so I used my personal card to get cash for taxi + meals. The card statement shows a €5 ATM surcharge + a 2.5% foreign transaction fee. Can I get reimbursed for the cash withdrawal amount + the ATM surcharge? Not sure about the FX fee.
Maria Gomez: Sorry that happened — ouch. Do you have a photo of the ATM receipt and the personal card transaction? We need both for auditing.
Alex Chen: Uploaded receipt in Drive: https://drive.redwood/reports/atm-170250 — receipt shows €60 dispensed, ATM fee €5. Personal card transaction shows €65.40 after FX. I can attach screenshots if needed.
Sam J: FYI company policy covers "necessary cash withdrawals for business travel" but ATM surcharges are evaluated case-by-case. FX fees (credit card conversion fees) usually not reimbursed unless the corporate card couldn't be used at all, then we make an exception. Can @Maria confirm?
Maria Gomez: @Sam J correct. If corporate card declined and there was no other way to pay, we typically reimburse the base amount + ATM surcharge. FX markup is trickier — we reimburse the official converted amount per the receipt and the bank statement, but not the card issuer's convenience fee. Please submit expense with: 1) ATM receipt, 2) bank statement line, 3) short note saying corporate card declined + attempted terminal swipe, and 4) the trip itinerary.
Alex Chen: Got it. I'll upload the bank statement line and add a note that the Redwood corp card declined at the ATM (it showed "card not supported"). Anything else I should call out in the expense form?
Maria Gomez: Add the card decline time and the last 4 digits of the corp card you tried (we'll redact later). Also tag the expense as "travel - taxi/meals" and set currency to EUR. That helps automated matching.
Finance Bot: Policy snippet: "ATM surcharges may be reimbursed when the corporate card is unavailable and withdrawal is required for business expenses. FX convenience fees charged by personal cards are not reimbursed unless pre-approved." Link: https://intranet.redwood/fin/policies/atm-fx
Alex Chen: Thanks — submitting now. If finance approves I'll include a note to waive FX fee. Appreciate the quick replies :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Sounds good. I'll review once submitted. If all docs present we'll approve the ATM surcharge and the base EUR amount; we'll deny the issuer FX markup unless you can show no alternative existed (looks like you already did).
